tool.name: LangSmith
tool.description: Framework-agnostic platform from LangChain for tracing, monitoring, evaluating and deploying LLM apps and agents, with OpenTelemetry ingest.
strengths: Works beyond LangChain (OpenAI, CrewAI, Vercel AI)
Cloud in US, EU, APAC and AWS regions
Self-hosted and hybrid options on Enterprise
tool.pricing: Developer $0/seat (5k base traces/month), Plus $39/seat/month (10k base traces/month) then pay-as-you-go, Enterprise custom.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.
tool.practitionerNote: The lowest-friction option for LangChain and LangGraph shops, but it also ingests OpenTelemetry from other stacks. Base traces keep only 14 days (extended traces 180), and audit logs, self-hosting and hybrid all need the Enterprise plan.

dataResidency.detail: SaaS regions include GCP us-central1, europe-west4 and australia-southeast1, plus AWS us-east-2. Enterprise can self-host. Payment data is stored in the US.

deployment.detail: Cloud SaaS on all plans. Hybrid and self-hosted (Kubernetes in customer infrastructure) are Enterprise add-ons.

auditLogging.detail: Tamper-resistant audit logs of administrative and configuration actions, available only on Enterprise plans.

soc2.detail: The LangChain Trust Center did not render verifiable certification details, and the LangSmith cloud docs make no SOC 2 claim.

iso27001.detail: No ISO 27001 claim could be verified on the LangSmith docs or a rendered Trust Center page.

iso42001.detail: No ISO 42001 claim could be verified on the LangSmith docs or a rendered Trust Center page.

euAiAct.detail: Observability and evaluation tooling, not an AI system placed on the market. Obligations rest with the deployer.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary SaaS. Self-hosting is an Enterprise add-on with no open-source path.
